response.original_title: スゴEフェス 2026 生放送スペシャル うたでえがおに
response.overview: In celebration of "World Children's Day" on November 20th, the "Sugo-E Fes" arrives to cheer on children! This year’s theme is "Bringing Smiles Through Song." Featuring popular hits and classic favorites from E-Tele programs, the event delivers joy through special, cross-program performances. Highlights include a 30th-anniversary celebration for "Zawazawa Mori no Ganko-chan" and a special stage for "Inai Inai Baa!", alongside a star-studded lineup featuring Tatsuya Kitani, Kyary Pamyu Pamyu, Ryuga Sato (ACEes), Airi Suzuki, Ai Higuchi, and more!
